description: Update an issue: status, resolution, assignment, and flags.

assigned_to.description: User or team to assign the issue to.

has_seen.description: Whether the issue is marked as seen.

is_subscribed.description: Whether the caller is subscribed to the issue.

resolved_in_next_release.description: Whether to mark the issue as resolved in the next release.

status.description: New status for the issue, such as "resolved", "unresolved", or "ignored".

name: update_issue
